podcast.body: A song from their 2016 album "California." At almost four minutes in length, it is noted as one of the longest Blink 182 songs in history, as the band rarely extends beyond the three-minute mark. "That's one of the longest Blink songs in history."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Rise and Fall and Rise of Blink 182 Part 2

podcast.body: This single from the *California* album was released in the Matt Skiba era and quickly became the biggest thing the band had done in years. Both the single and its parent album went gold, marking a significant comeback. "There was a single called Bored to Death, and it was the biggest thing they'd done in years."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song from their 2016 album *California* was among those Blink-182 had planned to perform at the ill-fated Fyre Festival. However, the band pulled out just hours before the festival's start due to concerns about payment and inadequate production facilities. "Bored to death from Blink 1 and 2's 2016 album, California. They were planning to play that song at the Fire Festival before they wised up and pulled out."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
